m05_86.say: Thanks for joining today's webinar on maximizing e-commerce conversion rates. One of the easiest revenue wins for any online store owner is optimizing your abandoned-cart email sequence. Yet the single biggest mistake I see brands make is immediately offering a 15 or 20 percent discount in the very first email sent one hour after a shopper leaves. All that does is train savvy shoppers to abandon their carts on purpose just to trigger a coupon! Instead, keep your first email a helpful, no-discount reminder. Then, in your second follow-up email 24 hours later, try testing customer reviews or social proof—such as a 4.9-star rating or a real buyer photo—to overcome hesitation without sacrificing your profit margin.

Why Heritage Retailers Are Turning Stores into Mini-Fulfillment Hubs
By Rachel Dawson | Retail Insider Weekly

Facing rising last-mile parcel rates from national carriers, major apparel and home-goods chains are rethinking the role of their suburban storefronts. Rather than treating brick-and-mortar shops solely as display showrooms, brands like Harbor & Oak and Crestline Apparel now fulfill up to 40 percent of local online orders directly from store backrooms—a model known as "ship-from-store."

By tapping into store-level inventory, retailers achieve two simultaneous wins: they cut cross-country shipping distances, often delivering packages within 24 hours, and they reduce the need for end-of-season markdowns on slow-moving sizes sitting on regional shelves.

However, the strategy is not without operational hurdles. Store associates, already stretched thin assisting walk-in shoppers, must now pick, pack, and label dozens of e-commerce parcels each morning. "Without real-time inventory synchronization, a store might promise an online buyer the very last medium jacket—only for a walk-in customer to buy it off the rack ten minutes later," warns retail analyst Marcus Sterling.

How Storytelling Transformed a Struggling Luggage Brand

Five years ago, Meridian Carry Co. was indistinguishable from dozens of mid-tier luggage brands competing solely on price and polycarbonate shell thickness. [1] Sales had plateaued, and paid search ads were yielding diminishing returns as larger conglomerates outbid smaller players for generic keywords like "carry-on suitcase."

Instead of slashing prices, newly appointed Chief Marketing Officer Sofia Alvarez pivoted the brand's narrative from product specs to emotional longevity. Rather than airbrushing away dents and scratches, the campaign celebrated wear and tear as badges of adventure.

"Customers don't want to buy a disposable plastic box every three years," Alvarez explained at last week's Brand Builders Forum. [4] "When you show them that a product ages gracefully alongside their memories, price ceases to be the primary objection."

explain.text:
• 考點：建議事項細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性提議 brainstorm three alternative taglines，男性接著說 pull in the copywriters，同義替換為 (B) Drafting multiple new slogan options with the writing team（three alternative taglines → multiple new slogan options、copywriters → writing team）。
• 誘答分析：(A) finalizing the media buy slides 是女性之前已做的事（時態錯置）；(C) 未提及查閱對手銷售數據；(D) 男性提議訂 2:00 P.M. 會議室，並非取消。
• 單字補充：slogan (標語)、copywriter (文案撰稿人)。

questions.q: Why are the speakers holding an urgent meeting?
options: Consumers reported adverse skin reactions linked to a specific production run.
Social media influencers refused to promote a new skincare line.
Quality Assurance misplaced retention samples from Lot 204.
Warehouse staff accidentally shipped expired Vitamin C serum.

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨與原因辨識（同義替換）。
• 解析：David 提到 three customers posted photos overnight showing skin irritation after using our Vitamin C serum—all from Lot 204，對應 (A) Consumers reported adverse skin reactions linked to a specific production run（skin irritation → adverse skin reactions、Lot 204 → specific production run）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文提及社群帳號被標記，非網紅拒絕合作；(C) QA 是去「調出」留樣，非遺失；(D) 對話未提及產品過期。
• 單字補充：adverse reaction (不良反應)、production run (生產批次)。

questions.q: What does Elena say should be done immediately?
options: Contacting every customer who tagged the brand online
Sending retention samples from all product lines to an outside lab
Suspending all retail and digital distribution of the questionable batch
Issuing a formal press statement with Legal

explain.text:
• 考點：優先行動細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Elena 說 our absolute top priority must be halting all online and in-store sales of that specific batch immediately，對應 (C) Suspending all retail and digital distribution of the questionable batch（halting → Suspending、online and in-store sales → retail and digital distribution）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 發新聞稿是等 QA 初步報告後才進行，非最優先；(A) 聯絡顧客是 Marcus 標記後由客服私下進行；(B) 原文僅說 QA 內部實驗室檢測，未提送外部實驗室。
• 單字補充：suspend (暫停)、distribution (銷售/配送通路)。

questions.q: What is Marcus assigned to do?
options: Draft the official press release for media outlets
Track online public reactions and escalate relevant complaints
Conduct laboratory testing on the returned serum bottles
Lock the remaining inventory inside the warehouse

explain.text:
• 考點：人員分工細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Elena 要求 Marcus monitor all social media comments and DMs closely and flag any additional Lot 204 reports，對應 (B) Track online public reactions and escalate relevant complaints。
• 誘答分析：(A) Marcus 主動問要不要寫新聞稿，但被 Elena 接手（經典「問了但沒做」陷阱）；(D) 鎖定倉庫庫存是 David 的工作；(C) 實驗室檢測由 QA 負責。
• 單字補充：escalate (上報/升級處理)、flag (標記)。

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
options: To reschedule Friday's courier pickup for next week
To complain about rain damage on a previous cardboard shipment
To change the screen-printing design on 2,000 tote bags
To check on the production and shipping status of branded merchandise

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的（上位概念替換）。
• 解析：Rachel 來電說 calling to check on our order of 2,000 reusable promotional tote bags，對應 (D) To check on the production and shipping status of branded merchandise（promotional tote bags → branded merchandise）。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆借用對話詞彙 Friday's courier、screen printing、cardboard 製造陷阱，與實際來電目的不符。
• 單字補充：branded merchandise (品牌周邊商品)、screen printing (網版印刷)。

questions.q: What concern does the man acknowledge?
options: Standard paperboard containers could absorb moisture during loading.
The screen printing might not finish before Friday's pickup.
The courier may refuse to pick up 2,000 bags at once.
The waterproof plastic wrap is currently out of stock.

explain.text:
• 考點：問題與顧慮細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：男性說 Standard cardboard cartons could get damp on the loading dock if it pours，同義替換為 (A) Standard paperboard containers could absorb moisture during loading（cardboard cartons → paperboard containers、get damp → absorb moisture）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 印刷今早已完成；(D) 男性承諾會用防水塑膠膜包好，並未缺貨；(C) 未提及快遞拒收。
• 單字補充：absorb moisture (吸收濕氣)、shrink-wrap (熱縮膜包裝)。

questions.q: What does the man agree to send the woman?
options: A revised weather forecast for the loading dock
An electronic image of the completed item for sign-off
A tracking number for Friday's courier delivery
A sample tote bag sealed in a cardboard carton

explain.text:
• 考點：承諾事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性請求 email me a quick digital photo of the finished bag print for final sign-off，男性答應照辦，對應 (B) An electronic image of the completed item for sign-off（digital photo → electronic image）。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆拼湊對話中的 weather forecast、Friday's courier、cardboard carton 等字眼誘答。
• 單字補充：sign-off (最終確認核可)、electronic image (電子影像)。

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: Lowering fulfillment expenses for quarterly beauty boxes
Addressing a drop-off in repeat subscribers after the third billing cycle
Redesigning the packaging for lip balms and skincare samples
Shortening shipping times to compete with rival services

explain.text:
• 考點：對話主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人討論美妝訂閱盒 Q2 流失率報告 Retention drops sharply right after month three，對應 (B) Addressing a drop-off in repeat subscribers after the third billing cycle。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 均借用原文 fulfillment costs、lip balms、shipping speed 等詞彙誤導。
• 單字補充：churn (客戶流失率)、billing cycle (計費週期)。

questions.q: According to the man's survey, why are members leaving?
options: Packages frequently arrive with damaged lip balms.
The web selector tool is too complicated to use.
Monthly subscription fees were raised without warning.
The assortment of items lacks variety over time.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：男性指出離退調查首因是 subscribers feel the product selection is getting repetitive，對應 (D) The assortment of items lacks variety over time（product selection → assortment of items、repetitive → lacks variety）。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A) 原文明確說「不是價格也不是配送速度（isn't price or shipping speed）」；(B) 網頁選擇器是還沒開發的提案，非離退原因。
• 單字補充：assortment (商品組合)、variety (多樣性)。

questions.q: What does the woman recommend?
options: Allowing members to personalize part of their monthly shipment
Limiting each box to two curated beauty products
Extending the billing cycle to every 48 days
Surveying the web team about fulfillment costs

explain.text:
• 考點：解決方案（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性提議 introduce a build-your-own customization window... Subscribers could swap out up to two items，同義改寫為 (A) Allowing members to personalize part of their monthly shipment。
• 誘答分析：(C) 48 是「小時」（客製化開放時窗），非 48 天計費週期；(D) 詢問網頁團隊的是開發時程，非物流成本；(B) 並非限制整盒只有兩樣商品，而是可替換最多兩樣。
• 單字補充：personalize (客製化)、curated (精選的)。

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to verify?
options: Whether existing agreements permit commercial promotion of influencer content
Whether all twelve creators have posted their holiday videos
Whether the Meta ad campaign can be delayed until Tuesday
Whether the talent agency signed the three-month contract

explain.text:
• 考點：確認事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性問 whether all twelve influencer contracts include paid-ad usage rights，對應 (A) Whether existing agreements permit commercial promotion of influencer content（contracts → agreements、paid-ad usage rights → permit commercial promotion）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 活動週一才上線，尚未發文；(C) 活動還沒決定延期；(D) 經紀公司要求的是「三個月」，並非已簽署三個月合約。
• 單字補充：usage rights (使用權限)、commercial promotion (商業推廣)。

questions.q: What does the man imply when he says, "Legal still hasn't signed off on the revised clause"?
options: Ten of the twelve influencers will have to be replaced.
Paid Meta ads will run for three months instead of six.
The legal team rejected the six-month usage addendum on Tuesday.
Two creators' content cannot yet be used in paid advertisements.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（Implication）。
• 解析：女性接著說 Without that signature, we can't boost their posts on Monday，說明這兩位創作者的貼文暫時無法投入付費廣告推廣，對應 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 並未說要替換十位網紅；(C) 法務是「還沒簽核」，並非「拒絕」；(B) 六個月的附約仍在等簽核，並非改為三個月。
• 單字補充：boost a post (付費推廣貼文)、addendum (合約附錄)。

questions.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?
options: Launch the holiday creator campaign without the two videos
Contact the talent agency to negotiate a shorter term
Visit the legal department in person to expedite the paperwork
Send the revised addendum to Daniel by 5:00 P.M.

explain.text:
• 考點：未來行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性說 I'll walk over to the legal counsel's office this afternoon and ask if they can prioritize it，對應 (C) Visit the legal department in person to expedite the paperwork。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 皆借用原文 talent agency、holiday creator campaign、5:00 P.M. 等詞彙製造錯置陷阱。
• 單字補充：expedite (加速處理)、in person (親自前往)。

questions.q: What kind of company do the speakers work for?
options: A print magazine publisher
A business specializing in rugged outdoor gear
A digital video production studio
A loyalty software provider

explain.text:
• 考點：推論公司類型（同義替換）。
• 解析：Liam 提到產品為 waterproof hiking jackets and trail gear，對應 (B) A business specializing in rugged outdoor gear。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆由對話中提到的推廣管道（Print magazine、short-form... videos、loyalty program）延伸誘答，非公司本業。
• 單字補充：rugged (耐用的/戶外的)、trail gear (越野登山裝備)。

questions.q: What does Priya highlight from the third-quarter data?
options: Updated member perks led to a higher rate of completed online purchases.
Early-access drops caused a temporary dip in August sales.
Trail-testing videos outperformed the loyalty program in conversion rate.
Print magazine advertisements drove 40 percent of new visits.

explain.text:
• 考點：報告重點細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Priya 說會員制度改版並推出搶先購後，our online conversion rate jumped from 2.4 percent to 3.8 percent，對應 (A) Updated member perks led to a higher rate of completed online purchases（loyalty program revamp → Updated member perks、conversion rate jumped → higher rate of completed online purchases）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 40% 新訪客是短影音帶來的，非平面雜誌；(B) 原文未提銷售下滑；(C) 對話未比較短影音與會員制度的轉換率。
• 單字補充：perks (會員福利)、conversion rate (轉換率)。

questions.q: What do the speakers agree to do for the winter campaign?
options: Discontinue early-access drops for loyalty members
Reallocate a portion of traditional print funding toward short video content
Hire Jordan to film new waterproof jacket commercials
Increase the overall winter marketing budget by 15 percent

explain.text:
• 考點：最終決議（同義替換）。
• 解析：Priya 提議且 Liam 同意 shift 15 percent of our print ad budget directly into short-form video production，對應 (B) Reallocate a portion of traditional print funding toward short video content。
• 誘答分析：(D) 是「轉移」15% 預算，而非總預算增加 15%；(A) 搶先購成效極佳，不會取消；(C) Jordan 的工作是更新媒體預算表，而非拍廣告。
• 單字補充：reallocate (重新配置)、funding (資金/預算)。

questions.q: What is the man's position at the company?
options: He supervises email subscriber communications.
He directs brand aesthetic and homepage design.
He oversees online product strategy and inventory movement.
He manages spring warehouse storage facilities.

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者職位（同義替換）。
• 解析：男性自稱 E-commerce Merchandising Manager 且擔心冬季大衣庫存去化，對應 (C) He oversees online product strategy and inventory movement。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(A) 皆借用對話出現的 warehouse storage、brand aesthetic、email subscribers 誘答，但均非其職責。
• 單字補充：merchandising (商品企劃/陳列銷售)、oversee (監督管理)。

questions.q: Why does the woman object to the man's initial idea?
options: Email subscribers might complain about a 40 percent discount.
Warehouse storage fees are lower than the cost of a homepage banner.
The company cannot afford to sell 3,000 winter coats before February.
Steep public markdowns could erode the brand's upscale reputation.

explain.text:
• 考點：反對原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性認為 Slashing prices by 40 percent right on the homepage could cheapen our image（品牌定位為可負擔奢華），同義替換為 (D) Steep public markdowns could erode the brand's upscale reputation。
• 誘答分析：(C) 3,000 件是需要在二月前清掉的庫存目標，非「不能賣」；(B) 未比較倉儲費與橫幅成本；(A) 女性反而是擔心公開降價，而非訂閱戶抱怨。
• 單字補充：markdown (降價)、erode (侵蝕/損害)、upscale (高檔的)。

questions.q: What compromise do the speakers decide on?
options: Removing the winter coats from the website until spring
Hosting a brief, invitation-only promotion for mailing-list members
Paying extra warehouse fees to protect the brand aesthetic
Offering a 40 percent discount only to new website visitors

explain.text:
• 考點：折衷方案（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人達成共識 run a private 24-hour flash sale exclusively for our email subscribers，對應 (B) Hosting a brief, invitation-only promotion for mailing-list members（24-hour → brief、private... for email subscribers → invitation-only... for mailing-list members）。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆為未採納或歪曲對話細節的選項。
• 單字補充：invitation-only (僅限受邀者的)、mailing list (郵件名單)。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which channel's funding do the speakers agree to leave unchanged?
options: Affiliate Blogs
Email Retargeting
Social Video
Search Ads

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表與聽力交叉比對題。
• 解析：對話中兩人未直接唸出管道名稱，而是提到「每筆獲客成本最高（$30）且帶來 45,000 次點擊的管道」，並於最後同意 leave that channel's funding steady（維持預算不變）。對照表格，Cost per Acquisition 為 $30.00 且 Clicks 為 45,000 的項目正是 (C) Social Video。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A) 表格中 CPA 皆為 $20.00；(B) $10.00 CPA 的 Email Retargeting 是兩人決定「增加」預算的管道，非維持不變。
• 單字補充：cost per acquisition (單次獲客成本)、unchanged (維持不變)。

questions.q: What does the woman propose for the upcoming quarter?
options: Eliminating channels that generate fewer than 10,000 clicks
Shifting all Search Ads funding into email marketing
Reducing general overhead to match the $3,000 ad spend
Allocating more resources to the most cost-effective conversion channel

explain.text:
• 考點：建議事項細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性提議 double down on that most cost-effective conversion channel by increasing its budget，對應 (D) Allocating more resources to the most cost-effective conversion channel。
• 誘答分析：(C) 是從 general overhead 撥款，非將其降至 $3,000；(A)(B) 對話皆未提出刪除低點擊管道或挪用 Search Ads。
• 單字補充：cost-effective (具成本效益的)、overhead (一般管理費用)。

questions.q: What does the man point out about the $30-per-acquisition channel?
options: Its 45,000 clicks came mostly from general overhead campaigns.
It generated fewer conversions than Email Retargeting.
It is too expensive to maintain without cutting search ads.
It serves to build broad recognition that supports later purchases.

explain.text:
• 考點：補充說明細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：男性提醒 its primary goal is top-of-funnel brand awareness rather than immediate last-click sales，對應 (D) It serves to build broad recognition that supports later purchases（brand awareness → broad recognition）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 表格顯示 Social Video 轉換數（500）高於 Email（300）；(A)(C) 皆歪曲對話字眼。
• 單字補充：brand awareness (品牌知名度)、broad recognition (廣泛認知)。

questions.q: Why is the woman examining the renovation timeline?
options: To schedule shifts for the construction crew
To prepare wayfinding signs and shopper notifications
To arrange morning truck deliveries to the courtyard
To book VIP consultations on the third floor

explain.text:
• 考點：行動目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性說 I'm coordinating our in-store directional signage and customer email alerts，對應 (B) To prepare wayfinding signs and shopper notifications（directional signage → wayfinding signs、email alerts → shopper notifications）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 男性誤以為她是為 construction crew 看表，女性隨即否認；(C)(D) 為其他階段的相關事務，非她看表的原因。
• 單字補充：wayfinding (動線導引)、notification (通知)。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. During which dates will the store offer complimentary hot cider to waiting shoppers?
options: Nov 3 – Nov 10
Nov 11 – Nov 18
Nov 19 – Nov 26
Nov 27 – Nov 30

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表與聽力交叉比對題。
• 解析：對話中男性提到「在全館深度清潔與補貨期間（during the full-store deep clean and restock）將免費提供熱蘋果西打給等候的顧客」，但未唸出日期。對照圖表 Affected Area 欄位，對應 Full Store Deep Clean & Restock 的日期正是 (D) Nov 27 – Nov 30。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 分別對應前三個施工階段的日期，均非提供熱飲的時段。
• 單字補充：complimentary (免費招待的)、deep clean (深度清潔)。

questions.q: What does the man mention about the West Courtyard?
options: Customers will pick up online orders there during Phase 4.
Directional signage has already been placed by the side entrance.
The pop-up tent will close early at 9:00 A.M. for cleaning.
Freight vehicles occupy the space during early morning hours.

explain.text:
• 考點：特定地點限制（同義替換）。
• 解析：男性指出 delivery trucks use the West Courtyard every morning until 9:00 A.M.，對應 (D) Freight vehicles occupy the space during early morning hours（delivery trucks → Freight vehicles）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 帳篷是 9:30 A.M. 才「開始營業」，非 9:00 A.M. 關門清潔；(B)(A) 皆混淆其他階段內容。
• 單字補充：freight vehicle (貨運車輛)、occupy (佔用)。

questions.q: What triggered the initial wave of customer dissatisfaction?
options: The $15 vouchers could not be applied to the extended sale.
The CEO's apology statement was delayed by one day.
Priority shipping upgrades failed to arrive on time.
The e-commerce platform went offline during a major promotion.

explain.text:
• 考點：事件起因（同義替換）。
• 解析：男性說首日負評暴增是因為 the site went down during the flash sale，對應 (D) The e-commerce platform went offline during a major promotion（went down → went offline、flash sale → major promotion）。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 皆借用後續幾天的補救措施（CEO apology、priority shipping、$15 voucher）反推成起因，時序錯置。
• 單字補充：go offline (離線/當機)、dissatisfaction (不滿)。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. On which date did the team host an extra influencer livestream?
options: Oct 14
Oct 15
Oct 16
Oct 17

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表與聽力交叉比對題。
• 解析：女性在對話中說「就在正面提及數終於超過負面提及數的那一天（on the very day positive mentions finally outnumbered negative ones），我們加開了一場網紅直播」，但未講出日期。查閱圖表，10 月 14、15 日負評仍多於好評，直到 (C) Oct 16 好評（640）才首度超越負評（410）。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B) 兩日負評皆遠高於好評；(D) 10 月 17 日是升級優先配送的最後一天，並非「首度」超越日。
• 單字補充：outnumber (數量超過)、momentum (動能/氣勢)。

questions.q: What does the woman want to add to the executive summary presentation?
options: Verbatim praise from buyers who benefited from faster delivery
A breakdown of the 890 negative mentions from the crash
A proposal to extend the flash sale by another four days
Screenshots of the $15 voucher redemption numbers

explain.text:
• 考點：報告內容需求（同義替換）。
• 解析：女性希望報告放入 actual quotes from delighted customers who posted about receiving their priority-upgraded packages early，對應 (A) Verbatim praise from buyers who benefited from faster delivery（actual quotes → Verbatim praise）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 890 是最後一天的「正面」提及數，非負面；(D)(C) 均曲解對話細節。
• 單字補充：verbatim (逐字的/原話的)、executive summary (高階主管摘要)。

questions.q: What decision is the man struggling with?
options: Whether to hire a traditional billboard agency for the spring campaign
Whether to offer unique promo codes to all thirty celebrities
Whether to partner with a small number of major stars or many smaller creators

A five-day extension on the return window

• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 皆借用 portal、refund、return 等相關詞彙編造錯誤程序。
• 單字補充：serial number (序號)、verify (核對確認)。

questions.q: Why has the speaker called this press conference?
options: To announce the permanent closure of an overseas factory
To introduce a new overseas garment subcontractor
To respond to accusations concerning working conditions at a supplier's plant
To present the company's annual worker welfare report

explain.text:
• 考點：記者會目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者說明召開簡報是為了回應媒體對某海外代工廠「超時加班與通風不良」的指控，對應 (C) To respond to accusations concerning working conditions at a supplier's plant（allegations → accusations、factory labor practices → working conditions at a supplier's plant）。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 皆借用 overseas、subcontractor、worker welfare 編造陷阱。
• 單字補充：accusation (指控)、subcontractor (分包商/代工廠)。

questions.q: What step has Loom & Thread already taken?
options: Resumed purchase orders with the subcontractor after ventilation repairs
Commissioned an outside firm to perform an unscheduled inspection
Ended all business ties with its current auditing firm
Paid overtime compensation to the affected factory workers

explain.text:
• 考點：已採取行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者表示昨早已經聘請獨立第三方稽核機構 VerityAudit 進行「無預警全面檢查（unannounced, full-scale inspection）」，對應 (B) Commissioned an outside firm to perform an unscheduled inspection（retained an independent third-party → Commissioned an outside firm、unannounced → unscheduled）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 公司是「暫停新訂單」，並非終止與稽核機構的合作；(D)(A) 與事實相反。
• 單字補充：commission (委託)、unscheduled (無預警/臨時的)。

questions.q: What does the speaker imply when she says, "We will publish the unedited findings on our corporate transparency portal by November 30"?
options: The complete audit outcome will be shared publicly without selective editing.
Media outlets will receive an exclusive summary prior to public release.
The independent auditors will manage the company's website directly.
Only corrective timelines will appear on the portal before November 30.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（Implication）。
• 解析：講者承諾 publish the unedited findings on our corporate transparency portal by November 30，意即無論稽核結果好壞都將完整公開、不做篩選刪減，對應 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆曲解 unedited 與 November 30 的涵義。
• 單字補充：unedited (未經刪改的)、selective (選擇性的)。

questions.q: What recognition did the speaker's team receive?
options: A top industry honor for an integrated multi-channel retail initiative
A grant from the National Retail Federation for IT research
A prize for fastest inventory delivery times
An award for best in-store fitting room design

explain.text:
• 考點：獲獎名稱（同義替換）。
• 解析：團隊獲得 Omnichannel Campaign of the Year（年度全通路行銷活動獎），同義改寫為 (A) A top industry honor for an integrated multi-channel retail initiative（Omnichannel → integrated multi-channel）。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆借用演講出現的 fitting rooms、National Retail Federation、inventory 等詞彙誤導。
• 單字補充：initiative (計畫/活動)、integrated (整合的)。

questions.q: Whom does the speaker credit for the project's success?
options: Store-floor staff and technical software developers
External storytelling consultants
Emerging retail marketers who joined six months ago
The National Retail Federation judging panel

explain.text:
• 考點：感謝對象（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者說這座獎盃屬於 our frontline retail associates... and our IT engineers，對應 (A) Store-floor staff and technical software developers（frontline retail associates → Store-floor staff、IT engineers → technical software developers）。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆借用 emerging talent、National Retail Federation、storytelling 等詞彙誘答。
• 單字補充：credit (歸功於)、prototype (原型)。

questions.q: What new initiative does the speaker reveal at the close of her remarks?
options: Publishing a case study on digital analytics next spring
Launching a coaching program to develop up-and-coming industry talent
Expanding real-time inventory syncing to international stores
Opening applications for summer IT engineering internships

explain.text:
• 考點：結尾新計畫宣布（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者宣布明春將推出 a new mentorship program for young retail marketers to help emerging talent，對應 (B) Launching a coaching program to develop up-and-coming industry talent（mentorship program → coaching program、emerging talent → up-and-coming industry talent）。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 皆借用 real-time inventory、IT engineers、next spring 編造錯誤宣布內容。
• 單字補充：up-and-coming (有潛力的新秀)、coaching program (指導培育計畫)。

questions.q: To prevent customer frustration during peak holiday traffic, the IT team upgraded the e-commerce server capacity well _______ of the Black Friday sale.
options: forward
before
ahead
prior

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語搭配（ahead of）。
• 解析：well ahead of... 為固定搭配，意為「遠早於……之前」；副詞 well 修飾介系詞片語 ahead of。
• 誘答分析：(A) forward 不與 of 連用表示時間提前；(D) prior 需搭配 to（prior to）；(B) before 不接 of。
• 單字補充：server capacity (伺服器容量)、peak traffic (尖峰流量)。

questions.q: Following the misleading advertisement controversy, the brand's public relations director issued a statement _______ full responsibility for the oversight.
options: assume
assuming
assumption
assumed

explain.text:
• 考點：現在分詞作後位修飾。
• 解析：名詞 a statement 主動「承擔」責任，故用現在分詞 assuming（= which assumed）修飾 statement。
• 誘答分析：(D) assumed 為過去分詞（表被動）；(C) 名詞無法直接接名詞片語受詞；(A) 原形動詞文法錯誤。
• 單字補充：assume responsibility (承擔責任)、oversight (疏忽)。

questions.q: _______ the steep rise in digital advertising costs, many direct-to-consumer retailers are investing more heavily in organic community building.
options: Provided
Although
Whereas
Given

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞用法（Given 表「考量到」）。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the steep rise...，需填入介系詞；Given 可作介系詞，意為「鑒於／考量到……」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆為從屬連接詞，後須接完整子句，不可只接名詞片語。
• 單字補充：direct-to-consumer (DTC) (直接面向消費者)、organic community building (自然流量社群經營)。

questions.q: Shoppers who enroll in the VIP tier are entitled to complimentary alterations _______ the original purchase price of the garment.
options: regardless of
owing to
in addition
on behalf of

explain.text:
• 考點：複合介系詞片語辨析。
• 解析：句意為「無論服飾原價多少，VIP 會員皆享有免費修改服務」，故選 (A) regardless of（不管／無論）。
• 誘答分析：(C) in addition 少 to 且語意不合；(B) owing to（因為）；(D) on behalf of（代表）。
• 單字補充：be entitled to (有權享有)、alterations (衣服修改)。

questions.q: The merchandising committee will review all seasonal display proposals _______ they are submitted before the October 15 deadline.
options: even though
rather than
in case of
as long as

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞辨析。
• 解析：句意為「只要在 10 月 15 日截止前提交，商品委員會就會審核所有季節陳列提案」，(D) as long as（只要）最符合。
• 誘答分析：(A) even though（儘管）語意相反；(C) in case of 為介系詞片語，後接名詞；(B) rather than（而非）。
• 單字補充：merchandising committee (商品陳列委員會)、submit (提交)。

questions.q: Analytics indicate that mobile users are _______ more likely to abandon their shopping carts if forced to create an account prior to checkout.
options: considerably
consideration
considerable
consider

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾比較級形容詞。
• 解析：空格修飾比較級 more likely，須用副詞 (A) considerably（相當地／顯著地）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 動詞；(C) 形容詞；(B) 名詞。
• 單字補充：abandon shopping carts (棄置購物車)、prior to checkout (結帳前)。

questions.q: Neither the regional store managers nor the marketing director _______ informed about the sudden change in the loyalty points expiration policy.
options: was
are
have been
were

explain.text:
• 考點：主謂一致（Neither A nor B 就近原則）＋時態。
• 解析：Neither A nor B 動詞須與較近的主詞 B（the marketing director，單數）一致，且語意為被動「被通知」，故選 (A) was。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆為複數動詞，與單數主詞不合。
• 單字補充：expiration policy (到期政策)、informed (被告知的)。

questions.q: To maintain brand consistency across all forty-two retail locations, store decorators must adhere _______ to the visual merchandising guidelines.
options: strict
stricter
strictly
strictness

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞片語（adhere strictly to）。
• 解析：空格修飾動詞 adhere，須使用副詞 (C) strictly（嚴格地）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 形容詞；(D) 名詞；(B) 比較級形容詞。
• 單字補充：adhere to (遵守)、visual merchandising (視覺陳列)。

questions.q: Had the PR team monitored the hashtag trends over the weekend, they _______ able to contain the rumor before it reached national news outlets.
options: would be
had been
would have been
will be

explain.text:
• 考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣（倒裝句）。
• 解析：Had the PR team monitored... = If the PR team had monitored...，為第三條件句（過去假設），主要子句須用 would have + p.p.，故選 (C) would have been。
• 誘答分析：(D) 未來式；(A) 現在假設；(B) 過去完成式，非主要子句結構。
• 單字補充：contain the rumor (控制/遏止謠言)、news outlet (新聞媒體)。

questions.q: The new warehouse automation software has _______ reduced the average time required to pack and ship an online order from two days to four hours.
options: dramatic
drama
dramatize
dramatically

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞（has dramatically reduced）。
• 解析：空格位於助動詞 has 與過去分詞 reduced 之間，須填入副詞 (D) dramatically（大幅地）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 形容詞；(B) 名詞；(C) 動詞。
• 單字補充：warehouse automation (倉儲自動化)、pack and ship (打包出貨)。

questions.q: Ms. Alvarez's presentation focused on how micro-influencers can _______ authentic engagement among niche consumer demographics.
options: cultivated
cultivating
cultivate
cultivation

explain.text:
• 考點：情態助動詞後接原形動詞＋字彙。
• 解析：can 後接原形動詞 (C) cultivate（培養／建立）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 名詞；(A) 過去式／分詞；(B) 動名詞／現在分詞。
• 單字補充：authentic engagement (真實互動)、niche demographic (利基客群)。

questions.q: All promotional banners featuring the celebrity spokesperson must be removed from storefront windows _______ the endorsement contract expires on December 31.
options: until
during
while
once

explain.text:
• 考點：時間連接詞辨析。
• 解析：句意為「一旦代言合約於 12 月 31 日到期，所有含該名人的促銷布條都必須撤下」，(D) once（一旦）最精準。
• 誘答分析：(A) until（直到……才撤下，若用 until 會變成「在到期前都要撤下」或語意矛盾）；(C) while（當……期間）；(B) during 為介系詞，後不可接子句。
• 單字補充：endorsement contract (代言合約)、expire (到期)。

questions.q: Because the limited-edition sneakers sold out within twelve minutes, the company decided to _______ a second production run for early next year.
options: authoritative
authorization
authority
authorize

explain.text:
• 考點：不定詞 to 後接原形動詞＋詞性辨析。
• 解析：decided to 後須接原形動詞 (D) authorize（核准／授權）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 名詞；(A) 形容詞；(B) 名詞。
• 單字補充：limited-edition (限量版)、production run (生產批次)。

questions.q: Customers requesting a refund without a receipt may still receive store credit, _______ they present a valid government-issued photo ID.
options: as though
provided that
unless
in order to

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞（provided that）。
• 解析：句意為「無收據退貨仍可獲購物金，前提是（只要）顧客出示有效附照片證件」，(B) provided that（倘若／只要）正確。
• 誘答分析：(C) unless（除非）語意相反；(A) as though（彷彿）；(D) in order to 後接原形動詞。
• 單字補充：store credit (門市購物金)、government-issued photo ID (政府核發附照片證件)。

questions.q: The crisis management consultant advised the CEO to avoid _______ language and instead state clearly what corrective steps were underway.
options: evasion
evasive
evasively
evade

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞修飾名詞＋危機公關字彙。
• 解析：空格修飾名詞 language，須用形容詞 (B) evasive（含糊其辭的／閃避的）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 動詞；(A) 名詞；(C) 副詞。
• 單字補充：evasive language (閃爍其詞的說法)、corrective steps (補救措施)。

questions.q: Compared with last year's holiday campaign, this quarter's email marketing series achieved a 14 percent higher _______ rate among repeat buyers.
options: convertible
conversion
converted
convert

explain.text:
• 考點：複合名詞搭配（conversion rate）。
• 解析：電商核心指標為 conversion rate（轉換率），名詞 conversion 作定語修飾 rate。
• 誘答分析：(D) 動詞；(A) 形容詞（可轉換的）；(C) 過去分詞。
• 單字補充：conversion rate (轉換率)、repeat buyer (回購顧客)。

questions.q: Every item returned through the online portal undergoes a thorough quality inspection _______ being restocked for resale.
options: except for
according to
prior to
instead of

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語＋動名詞。
• 解析：句意為「每件退貨在重新上架販售『之前』都須經過嚴格品檢」，(C) prior to（在……之前）符合語法與語意。
• 誘答分析：(D) instead of（而非）；(B) according to（根據）；(A) except for（除了）。
• 單字補充：restock (重新補貨上架)、resale (轉售)。

questions.q: The marketing vice president insisted that the revised privacy policy _______ prominently on the checkout screen before the new data-tracking feature goes live.
options: be displayed
displays
is displaying
to display

explain.text:
• 考點：建議／要求類動詞的假設語氣（insist that + S + (should) + V原形）＋被動語態。
• 解析：insisted that 後接的子句須使用原形動詞，且隱私權政策是「被顯示」，故為 (should) be displayed，選 (A) be displayed。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C) 皆為直說語氣現在式；(D) 不定詞不能作子句述語動詞。
• 單字補充：prominently (顯眼地)、go live (上線啟用)。

questions.q: _______ of the two competing packaging designs received unanimous approval from the focus group, prompting the creative team to draft a third option.
options: Neither
Either
None
Both

explain.text:
• 考點：否定代名詞辨析（兩者皆非 Neither）。
• 解析：句中有 two competing packaging designs，且後半句說「促使團隊草擬第三個方案」，可知兩者皆未獲一致通過，故選 (A) Neither。
• 誘答分析：(B) Either（兩者之一）；(D) Both（兩者皆是，與草擬第三案矛盾）；(C) None 用於三者或以上。
• 單字補充：unanimous approval (一致通過)、focus group (焦點團體)。

questions.q: By partnering with local couriers, the boutique grocer now guarantees same-day delivery for orders _______ before 2:00 P.M.
options: placing
placed
place
to place

explain.text:
• 考點：過去分詞片語作後位修飾。
• 解析：orders 與 place 為被動關係（被下達的訂單），故用過去分詞 (B) placed（= that are placed）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 主動分詞；(C) 原形動詞；(D) 不定詞表未來目的，不符。
• 單字補充：same-day delivery (當日配送)、local courier (當地快遞)。

questions.q: Despite initial skepticism from traditional investors, the brand's shift toward livestream shopping proved _______ profitable in the third quarter.
options: remarkable
remark
remarkably
remarked

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾形容詞。
• 解析：proved 作連綴動詞後接形容詞 profitable，空格須用副詞 (C) remarkably（顯著地／驚人地）修飾 profitable。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞/名詞；(A) 形容詞；(D) 過去分詞。
• 單字補充：skepticism (懷疑態度)、livestream shopping (直播帶貨)。

questions.q: The legal department is currently reviewing the influencer sponsorship agreement to ensure full _______ with federal advertising disclosure rules.
options: compliant
complied
comply
compliance

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞搭配（compliance with）。
• 解析：形容詞 full 後須接名詞 (D) compliance（遵循／合規），compliance with... 為固定搭配。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞；(A) 形容詞；(B) 過去分詞。
• 單字補充：disclosure rules (揭露規範)、sponsorship agreement (贊助合約)。

questions.q: _______ we finalize the Q4 media buying schedule, we will need confirmed inventory numbers from the footwear division.
options: Until
Upon
Before
Despite

explain.text:
• 考點：時間連接詞辨析。
• 解析：句意為「在我們定案 Q4 媒體採購時程『之前』，需要鞋類部門確認庫存數量」，(C) Before 符合邏輯。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B) 為介系詞，不可接子句；(A) Until 語意不合（「直到定案前都需要」邏輯怪異）。
• 單字補充：media buying schedule (媒體採購排程)、finalize (定案)。

questions.q: Consumers today are increasingly _______ about unverified sustainability claims, often checking third-party certifications before purchasing.
options: skepticism
skeptic
skeptically
skeptical

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞作主詞補語＋介系詞搭配（skeptical about）。
• 解析：are increasingly _______ about 需填入形容詞 (D) skeptical（持懷疑態度的）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 副詞；(A) 不可數名詞；(B) 可數名詞單數（缺冠詞）。
• 單字補充：sustainability claim (永續聲明)、third-party certification (第三方認證)。

questions.q: The pop-up boutique in Soho was originally scheduled to close on Sunday, _______ overwhelming foot traffic convinced management to extend it by two weeks.
options: otherwise
yet
moreover
therefore

explain.text:
• 考點：對等連接詞表轉折（yet）。
• 解析：前後兩句為完整子句且語意轉折（原定週日結束，『然而』人潮爆滿促使延長兩週），唯有 (B) yet 可直接連接兩個獨立子句。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 皆為副詞（conjunctive adverbs），不能僅用逗號連接兩個獨立子句。
• 單字補充：foot traffic (來客數)、extend (延長)。

questions.q: _______ to popular belief, offering free returns does not always reduce net profitability, as it often increases initial cart sizes.
options: Contrary
Contrast
Reverse
Opposite

explain.text:
• 考點：固定介系詞片語（Contrary to popular belief）。
• 解析：Contrary to popular belief 為標準搭配，意為「與普遍認知相反」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆不構成此慣用語。
• 單字補充：net profitability (淨獲利率)、cart size (客單金額/購物車大小)。

questions.q: Once the social media team _______ the negative comments, the customer care specialists will reach out to each affected buyer individually.
options: to catalog
will catalog
has cataloged
cataloging

explain.text:
• 考點：時間副詞子句的時態（以現在完成式代替未來完成式）。
• 解析：Once 引導的時間副詞子句不可用 will，可用現在簡單式或現在完成式 (C) has cataloged 表「一旦完成分類」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 未來式不可用於時間條件子句；(D)(A) 非限定動詞，缺述語動詞。
• 單字補充：catalog (分類建檔)、reach out to (主動聯繫)。

questions.q: The flagship store's grand reopening was _______ by a series of interactive workshops hosted by local textile artists.
options: accompanied
participated
attended
consisted

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞搭配與被動語態（be accompanied by）。
• 解析：句意為「旗艦店盛大重新開幕『伴隨著』一系列互動工作坊」，was accompanied by 完全正確。
• 誘答分析：(D) consist 用於主動 consist of；(B) participate in；(C) attend（出席）語意不合。
• 單字補充：grand reopening (盛大重新開幕)、textile artist (織品藝術家)。

questions.q: Sales associates are encouraged to _______ customers toward the mobile app, where they can check real-time stock availability across nearby branches.
options: direction
directly
directive
direct

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞詞性與句型（encourage sb. to V）。
• 解析：to 後接原形及物動詞 (D) direct（引導），direct customers toward... 意為「引導顧客使用……」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 副詞；(A)(C) 名詞。
• 單字補充：real-time stock availability (即時庫存狀態)、branch (分店)。

questions.q: _______ the severity of the supply chain disruption, the communications team kept media inquiries transparent and updated the public daily.
options: Regardless
In spite of
On behalf of
Even if

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步介系詞片語（In spite of）。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the severity of the supply chain disruption，且前後語意轉折（儘管供應鏈中斷嚴重，公關仍保持透明），故選 (B) In spite of。
• 誘答分析：(D) Even if 後接子句；(A) Regardless 缺 of；(C) On behalf of（代表）語意不合。
• 單字補充：severity (嚴重性)、transparent (公開透明的)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: as well
and also
but also
or else

explain.text:
• 考點：對等相關連接詞（not only... but also...）。
• 解析：前有 not only to reduce...，後接 (C) but also to drive...，維持平行結構。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 皆無法與 not only 構成正確搭配。
• 單字補充：textile waste (紡織廢棄物)、roll out (推出)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: These encouraging figures confirm that sustainability efforts can directly support revenue growth.
Therefore, we have decided to discontinue the $15 voucher for online-only shoppers.
Most customers preferred receiving cash refunds rather than store credit.
Unfortunately, shipping delays prevented the Austin store from participating in the trial.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（承上啟下）。
• 解析：前句提到試行分店有 68% 領券顧客當次消費滿 $80，空格應總結此正向數據的意義，(A) These encouraging figures confirm that sustainability efforts can directly support revenue growth. 最連貫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆與前句正向數據矛盾。
• 單字補充：preliminary trial (初步試行)、recipient (領取者)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: Meanwhile
Nevertheless
Consequently
Otherwise

explain.text:
• 考點：轉折／並列連接副詞。
• 解析：前句說明門市人員須受訓，本句說明數位行銷團隊「同時」也會發布說明網頁，故選 (A) Meanwhile。
• 誘答分析：(D) 否則；(C) 因此；(B) 然而，皆不符兩團隊同步作業的語境。
• 單字補充：landing page (到達頁/活動專頁)、eligible (符合資格的)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: for
since
until
by

explain.text:
• 考點：時間介系詞辨析（by 表截止期限）。
• 解析：句意為「請『在週五下午前』審閱附上的訓練簡報」，by + 時間點 表「不遲於……」。
• 誘答分析：(C) until 表動作持續到某時點（review 非持續性動詞）；(B) since；(A) for 接時間段。
• 單字補充：training deck (訓練簡報檔)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: so that
although
because
unless

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步連接詞（although）。
• 解析：前句說 App 可能顯示不準確的沸騰警示，後句說「沒有接獲任何安全危害或硬體瑕疵通報」，語意轉折，故選 (B) although。
• 誘答分析：(C) 因為；(D) 除非；(A) 以便（表目的），語意不合。
• 單字補充：software update (軟體更新)、hardware defect (硬體瑕疵)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: Even though
As if
In case
Now that

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步連接詞（Even though）。
• 解析：CEO 表示「『儘管』此問題純屬軟體層面且影響不到 2% 產品，我們仍立即採取步驟解決」，選 (A) Even though。
• 誘答分析：(C) 萬一；(D) 既然；(B) 彷彿，皆不合。
• 單字補充：cornerstone (基石)、underway (進行中)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: The Model K-900 will be replaced by an entirely manual stainless-steel version next spring.
Affected buyers must mail their appliances back to the Seattle factory at their own expense.
Retail stores will stop carrying all VerveBrew coffee grinders indefinitely.
Users simply need to open the app while their kettle is connected to Wi-Fi to begin the download.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（操作步驟說明）。
• 解析：前句說明可透過 App 進行三分鐘無線軟體更新，(D) Users simply need to open the app while their kettle is connected to Wi-Fi to begin the download. 具體說明下載方式，銜接最自然。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 均與「三分鐘免費軟體更新」的輕鬆基調相左。
• 單字補充：wireless update (無線更新)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: whom
which
where
whose

explain.text:
• 考點：關係副詞（where 引導非限定定語從句）。
• 解析：先行詞為 our dedicated support hotline，後方子句 specialists are available... 結構完整，缺地點／抽象場所副詞，故用 (C) where。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A) 為關係代名詞，後方缺主詞或受詞才可用；(D) 所有格後須接名詞。
• 單字補充：dedicated hotline (專屬客服專線)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: interruption
interrupt
interrupted
interrupting

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞字彙搭配（service interruption）。
• 解析：動詞 avoid 後須接名詞片語受詞，service interruption（服務中斷）為標準商業搭配，選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞；(C) 過去分詞；(D) 動名詞後面不這樣搭配複合名詞。
• 單字補充：switch to (切換至)、older (舊版的)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: However, v1.8 will remain available for desktop browsers until next year.
Payment processing fees will triple for merchants who switch early.
These enhancements are specifically designed to eliminate friction for on-the-go shoppers.
Consequently, merchants are advised to raise their minimum free-shipping thresholds.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（承接功能介紹）。
• 解析：前句介紹一鍵生物辨識錢包與自動稅額計算，後句說行動結帳完成率提升 11%，故中間應填入 (C) These enhancements are specifically designed to eliminate friction for on-the-go shoppers.。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆與前後文正面效益不符。
• 單字補充：digital wallet (數位錢包)、friction (結帳阻礙)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: Unless
If
Whether
Despite

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞（If）。
• 解析：句意為「『如果』您的商店依賴第三方外掛程式，請向開發商確認相容性」，選 (B) If。
• 誘答分析：(A) 除非；(D) 介系詞，不可接子句；(C) Whether 單獨使用不引導此類祈使條件句。
• 單字補充：third-party add-on tool (第三方附加工具)、compatible (相容的)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: will have posted
have been posted
had posted
are posting

explain.text:
• 考點：現在完成被動語態。
• 解析：主詞 Comprehensive transition guides and sample testing accounts 為複數且「已被張貼」在商家後台，故選 (B) have been posted。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 皆為主動語態，主詞「指南與憑證」無法主動張貼。
• 單字補充：sample testing (測試環境)、transition guide (轉換指南)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: mutualize
mutuality
mutually
mutual

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾形容詞（mutually advantageous）。
• 解析：make + O + OC (形容詞) 中，advantageous 為形容詞，須由副詞 (C) mutually（雙方互利地）修飾。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(B) 名詞；(A) 動詞。
• 單字補充：demographic overlap (客群重疊度)、capsule collection (膠囊聯名系列)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: so that
because
in case
while

explain.text:
• 考點：對比連接詞（while）。
• 解析：句意為「PeakTrail 負責生產 10,000 個客製水壺，『而』TerraWear 則設計相應的輕量登山包」，對比雙方分工用 (D) while。
• 誘答分析：(B) 因為；(A) 以便；(C) 萬一，皆不符分工對比語氣。
• 單字補充：topographic pattern (等高線圖騰)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: TerraWear's previous collaboration with a footwear brand failed to meet sales projections.
Therefore, we recommend selling the bottles at a steep clearance discount from day one.
Unfortunately, our manufacturing plant is currently operating at maximum capacity until June.
In addition to shared product design, we envision a unified marketing campaign to maximize reach.

explain.text:

• 解析：該段後文談論「整合網紅寄送預算與合辦淨山活動以降低獲客成本」，故段首主題句應為 (D) In addition to shared product design, we envision a unified marketing campaign to maximize reach.。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 皆與聯合行銷推廣無關或相悖。
• 單字補充：earned media (贏得媒體/免費口碑曝光)、influencer seeding (網紅公關品寄送)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: terminations
terms
terminologies
terminals

explain.text:
• 考點：商業合約字彙辨析。
• 解析：revenue-sharing terms 意為「營收分潤條款」，選 (B) terms。
• 誘答分析：(C) 術語；(D) 終端機/航廈；(A) 終止，皆不合。
• 單字補充：revenue-sharing (營收分潤)。

questions.q: Why did Kevin Wu check the fulfillment dashboard?
options: To measure the paid boost performance of a viral TikTok video
To confirm whether a new shipment had reached the Chicago warehouse
To assess how much stock remained following a sudden jump in demand
To prepare the "Pre-order — Ships Nov 12" banner for the website

explain.text:
• 考點：細節與目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：Nora 說 Orders are spiking fast，Kevin 回覆 Let me check the fulfillment dashboard right now，接著回報芝加哥倉只剩 180 件，對應 (C) To assess how much stock remained following a sudden jump in demand（spiking → sudden jump in demand）。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(A) 皆借用對話中的 Chicago、Pre-order — Ships Nov 12、paid boost 等字眼編造錯誤目的。
• 單字補充：assess (評估)、fulfillment (訂單履約)。

questions.q: What does Kevin Wu plan to do regarding the TikTok post?
options: Add a direct link to the fulfillment dashboard
Remove it from the platform at 2:00 P.M.
Increase the paid boost until the 180 units sell out
Suspend promotional spending on that video

explain.text:
• 考點：未來行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：Kevin 說 I'll pause the paid boost on that post，同義替換為 (D) Suspend promotional spending on that video（pause → Suspend、paid boost → promotional spending）。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆錯置 2:00 P.M.、180 units 與 fulfillment dashboard 等詞彙。
• 單字補充：suspend (暫停)、promotional spending (推廣支出)。

questions.q: What is indicated about the promotion?
options: Gold Tier members may stack birthday vouchers with code GOLD25.
General public shoppers can use code GOLD25 starting Thursday morning.
Orders totaling $99 before discounts qualify for complimentary delivery.
Certain made-to-order lighting fixtures do not qualify for the markdown.

explain.text:
• 考點：排除條款細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：注意事項指出折扣碼不適用於 custom-order chandeliers（客製吊燈），上位概念改寫為 (D) Certain made-to-order lighting fixtures do not qualify for the markdown（custom-order → made-to-order、chandeliers → lighting fixtures）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 11 月 7 日僅限 Gold Tier 會員搶先購；(C) 須折扣「後」滿 $99（after discounts）；(A) 不可與生日券併用（cannot be combined）。
• 單字補充：made-to-order (客製訂做的)、markdown (折扣降價)。

questions.q: When does the VIP early access period end?
options: Thursday at 9:00 A.M. EST
Thursday at 8:59 P.M. EST
Friday at 8:59 A.M. EST
Friday at 9:00 P.M. EST

explain.text:
• 考點：活動時間細節。
• 解析：公告寫明 Early Access Window: Thursday, November 7 (9:00 A.M. EST) – Friday, November 8 (8:59 A.M. EST)，故結束時間為 (C) Friday at 8:59 A.M. EST。
• 誘答分析：(A) 為開始時間；(B)(D) 混淆 A.M./P.M. 與星期。
• 單字補充：early access (搶先體驗/優先購買)。

questions.q: What issue did the sixty-day analytics review uncover?
options: Desktop visitors abandon their carts 12 percentage points more often than mobile users.
Handheld-device shoppers frequently exit before finalizing their orders.
First-time buyers prefer a five-field registration form over guest checkout.
Unexpected shipping charges are omitted from the final payment screen.

explain.text:
• 考點：數據問題辨識（同義替換）。
• 解析：備忘錄指出手機端購物車放棄率達 69%，比桌機高出近 12 個百分點，對應 (B) Handheld-device shoppers frequently exit before finalizing their orders（mobile devices → Handheld-device、cart abandonment → exit before finalizing their orders）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 把手機與桌機的高低關係寫反；(D)(C) 歪曲 unexpected shipping fees 與 mandatory five-field registration form 的敘述。
• 單字補充：abandonment (放棄)、finalize (完成)。

questions.q: What is identified as a barrier for new customers?
options: A 12 percent fee added on mobile purchases
A streamlined guest checkout requiring an email address
A real-time free-shipping progress bar in the cart drawer
A required multi-field account creation step

explain.text:
• 考點：痛點細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文第二個摩擦點為 a mandatory five-field registration form for first-time buyers，同義替換為 (D) A required multi-field account creation step（mandatory → required、registration form → account creation step）。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B) 皆為即將推出的「解決方案」，並非原本的痛點；(A) 12% 是放棄率差距，非手續費。
• 單字補充：barrier (障礙)、streamlined (簡化的)。

questions.q: What is scheduled to begin by September 2?
options: The launch of Q4 holiday promotional campaigns
A Thursday project review of sample layouts
The removal of shipping fees from the payment screen
Comparative live trials of the updated purchase flow

explain.text:
• 考點：時程細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：末段寫道 so our technical team can begin split testing by September 2，對應 (D) Comparative live trials of the updated purchase flow（split testing → Comparative live trials）。
• 誘答分析：(A) Q4 活動 11 月才上線；(B) 版面審查是在週四（Thursday's project review）；(C) 9 月 2 日是開始測試，非移除運費。
• 單字補充：split testing (A/B 分流測試)、comparative trial (對照試驗)。

questions.q: Why is PureLeaf Organics recalling Lot #CH-884?
options: Specialty grocery stores distributed tins past the 08/2027 expiration date.
A flavoring supplier shipped 4,200 tins without Maya Lin's approval.
Several consumers reported soy allergies after drinking the tea.
Routine company screening uncovered an unlabeled ingredient.

explain.text:
• 考點：召回原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：新聞稿指出例行內部品質檢測發現未標示的 undeclared soy lecithin（大豆卵磷脂為常見過敏原），對應 (D) Routine company screening uncovered an unlabeled ingredient（internal quality testing → Routine company screening、undeclared → unlabeled）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 明確說明目前無過敏案例通報（no allergic reactions... have been reported）；(A)(B) 皆借用 08/2027、4,200 tins 與 Maya Lin 編造陷阱。
• 單字補充：unlabeled (未標示的)、screening (篩檢)。

questions.q: How can webstore shoppers obtain a digital reimbursement?
options: By uploading a picture of the batch identifier through an online portal
By contacting the flavoring vendor for a $10 goodwill voucher
By visiting a specialty grocery store with a receipt from October 22
By mailing the empty tea tin back to Portland, Oregon

explain.text:
• 考點：線上退款方式（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文指出線上退款可 submit a photo of the lot code at pureleaforganics.com/recall，對應 (A) By uploading a picture of the batch identifier through an online portal（photo → picture、lot code → batch identifier）。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆借用 Portland、specialty grocery store、flavoring vendor 製造錯誤流程陷阱。
• 單字補充：batch identifier (批次編號)、reimbursement (退款)。

questions.q: What has PureLeaf Organics done regarding the flavoring vendor?
options: It permanently terminated its supply contract on October 18.
It transferred all tea production to its official webstore.
It paused incoming deliveries while reviewing its supply chain.
It required the vendor to reimburse all 4,200 affected tins.

explain.text:
• 考點：對供應商的處置（同義替換）。
• 解析：CEO 表示 We have temporarily suspended shipments from the flavoring vendor while we conduct a comprehensive audit，對應 (C) It paused incoming deliveries while reviewing its supply chain。
• 誘答分析：(A) 是「暫時停貨」（temporarily suspended），非永久解約；(D)(B) 均無依據。
• 單字補充：comprehensive audit (全面稽核)、pause (暫停)。

questions.q: Why did Tiffany Park write to Jordan Blake?
options: To complain about the lighting and pacing of the draft Reels video
To ask for specific adjustments prior to approving a sponsored post
To revise the 50% milestone payment terms in their contract
To confirm that the Holiday Glow video is ready for November 10 release

explain.text:
• 考點：寫信目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：Tiffany 寫信表示核准發布前有兩項小修改請求（two minor requests），對應 (B) To ask for specific adjustments prior to approving a sponsored post（revision request → specific adjustments）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 尚未核准 11 月 10 日發布；(C) 並未重新談判 50% 付款條件；(A) 稱讚了燈光與節奏（lighting, pacing... are fantastic）。
• 單字補充：adjustment (調整/修改)、sponsored post (業配貼文)。

questions.q: Why must Jordan re-record the line at the 0:28 mark?
options: The "#AuraSkinPartner" tag was placed at 0:28 instead of the opening seconds.
The spoken statement exaggerated the product's verified effectiveness.
The compliance team wanted the morning skincare routine removed.
Product testing showed the serum works in seven days rather than two weeks.

explain.text:
• 考點：修改原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文指出 0:28 處說「七天完全消除黑斑」，但產品測試僅支持「兩週內明顯提亮膚色不均」，可見原台詞誇大了實證效果，對應 (B) The spoken statement exaggerated the product's verified effectiveness。
• 誘答分析：(A) 揭露標籤問題是在「開頭前三秒」，非 0:28；(D) 把「七天」與「兩週」寫反；(C) 稱讚了早晨保養流程。
• 單字補充：exaggerate (誇大)、verified effectiveness (經證實的效果)。

questions.q: When will the remaining 50% fee be issued?
options: Once the compliance team finishes testing the Holiday Glow Serum
Immediately after the "#AuraSkinPartner" caption is edited
Following the public release of the Reels video on November 10
Upon uploading the modified video file by Wednesday's deadline

explain.text:
• 考點：付款條件細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：信末提到 Once you upload the revised cut to the shared Drive folder by Wednesday at 5:00 P.M., I'll process your remaining 50% milestone payment right away，對應 (D) Upon uploading the modified video file by Wednesday's deadline。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 皆錯置 November 10、compliance team 等時間條件。
• 單字補充：milestone payment (階段性款項)、modified (修改後的)。

questions.q: When is a $7.95 deduction applied to a return?
options: When a buyer requests store credit upon carrier scan
When a sale item is dropped off at a physical NordicStep store
When a customer mails back a regular-priced item for a refund to the original card
When a shopper exchanges unworn shoes for a different size by mail

It surveyed social media users who shifted from 74% negative to 68% positive.

The single engraver assigned to the booth left at 2:00 P.M.

questions.q: According to Document 1, what condition applies to redeeming the $35 trade-in credit?

The credit can only be applied toward a footwear purchase of $120 or higher.
Customers must mail their worn shoes in a prepaid bag.
Customers must drop off their shoes at one of 18 retail stores by July 15.

questions.q: Why was Grace Lin worried during the August 18 Slack discussion?

Mail-in participants were redeeming their $35 credits too slowly.
Only 2,800 pairs of shoes had been collected in the first month.
More than 55% of returned shoes were being ground into track material.

questions.q: What behavioral difference is noted in Document 3?
options: In-store participants had a credit redemption rate of only 41%.
Mail-in shoppers spent an average of $168 on socks and apparel.
Shoppers who returned shoes in person used their credits at a much higher rate.
Mail-in participants returned 4,100 pairs compared to 2,300 in stores.

explain.text:

• 誘答分析：(D) 門市回收 4,100 雙高於郵寄 2,300 雙；(B) $168 是門市顧客的平均客單價；(A) 把 41% 張冠李戴給門市顧客。

questions.q: What percentage of shoes collected in Q3 were converted into track surfacing material?

questions.q: What policy change does Document 3 propose for Q1?

Raising the minimum spend for in-store credits to $168
